feedback: Written before this robot races. Iteration 3 (±0.03 m, 16 mm, kp 1.2, kd 0.4) scored 69.46, and iteration 5 reproduced it exactly, so this candidate's geometry is the best-supported platform. Iteration 2 to 3 showed that the wider 16 mm row needs kp near 1.2 because it shallows the steering slope. Iteration 4 widened to ±0.04 m and cut kp to 1.0 in the same race; progress fell on the s-bend (0.210 to 0.160) and oval (0.184 to 0.170), and line loss stayed at 1.0 per run. So the ±0.04 m row has not yet been tested at kp 1.2 on its own. Line loss persists at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run on all tracks and max error sits near 0.062 m, so the off-track limit is still the binding failure. Your current plan to hold ±0.03 m for this race is right. Do not expect a new best score from this candidate.
requested_changes: Next iteration, race the ±0.04 m row at 16 mm with y = 0.04 at kp 1.2 and kd 0.4, which isolates the widening from the gain change that confounded iteration 4.

If the ±0.04 m row at kp 1.2 still gives line loss of 1.0 or more per run, test a 12 mm footprint at the same ±0.04 m spacing, to check whether 16 mm edge noise is adding s-bend oscillation (iteration 3 s-bend oscillation was 0.168).
Keep y = 0.04 unless slalom steering oscillation reaches 0.15 or more; it has stayed at 0.145 to 0.147 across the row tests so far.
